comments.author: Hooshu
comments.body_html:
yes, you just need to add the ID inside the List in the medicals.json

Here’s how it would look for each stim:
{

“name”:“STIM NAME HERE”,
“_id”:“STIM ID HERE”,
“_props”:{
“StackMaxSize”:4
}

}

Don’t forget to add commas between each item.
